name: bake_model_loop
describe: Model-bake assembly/dispatch loop: per element/face, route each baked quad into the SimpleBakedModel buckets - general list if cullFace==null OR the model-rotation matrix is non-integer, else the per-facing list keyed by modelRotation.rotate(cullFace). Verbatim dispatch + EnumMap bucketing. REDUCED deps (the assembly never inspects them): makeBakedQuad -> a quad id input; ModelRotation.rotate -> a precomputed rotatedCullFace input. Quad baking itself is kernels 31-34.
